## Purpose
Fixes the primary bug in #57997: `/v1/messages` and `/v1/messages/count_tokens` return the OpenAI error envelope (with a Python `repr` inside the message) for request-validation failures, while handler-raised errors already use the documented Anthropic envelope. This adds route-aware handling in `validation_exception_handler` so both routes consistently return `{"type": "error", "error": {"type": "invalid_request_error", "message": ...}}` with a readable message instead of a Python dict repr.

## Not duplicating existing work
Per AGENTS.md's duplicate-work check: no open PR references #57997. #43380 touches the same general area (`vllm/entrypoints/anthropic/api_router.py`) but addresses a different, explicitly-separate part of the issue — mapping handler-raised exception class names (e.g. `NotFoundError`) to Anthropic's snake_case `error.type` vocabulary (e.g. `not_found_error`). This PR only changes `validation.py`'s pre-route FastAPI validation path and doesn't touch `api_router.py`, so it doesn't overlap with #43380.

## Test plan
    .venv/bin/python -m pytest --confcutdir=tests/entrypoints/serve/exception_handling tests/entrypoints/serve/exception_handling/test_validation_exception_handler.py -q
    .venv/bin/python -m pytest --confcutdir=tests/entrypoints tests/entrypoints/anthropic/test_anthropic_messages_conversion.py -q
    pre-commit run --files vllm/entrypoints/serve/exception_handling/handlers/validation.py tests/entrypoints/serve/exception_handling/test_validation_exception_handler.py tests/entrypoints/anthropic/test_anthropic_messages_conversion.py

Results: 27 passed / 66 passed / all pre-commit hooks passed (ruff, mypy, SPDX headers, forbidden-imports check, etc.)

New tests cover `/v1/messages` and `/v1/messages/count_tokens` for `max_tokens: 0`, missing required fields, an invalid role, and malformed JSON, both with and without a `root_path` prefix. A control test confirms non-Anthropic routes (e.g. `/v1/chat/completions`) keep the existing OpenAI error shape unchanged.

## AI assistance
Developed with AI assistance (Codex, then Claude Code). I reviewed every changed line, ran the tests and lint above myself, and understand the fix end-to-end.
